notes.title: NEODUEL v1.4.0 - Balance & Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
A quick balance pass focused on outliers at both ends. Also we fixed the reroll button which caused problems for many players.

Nerfs

Omnicore  
Cost 12 → 13

Demoncore  
Cost 12 → 13

Isvasal  
Cooldown 8 → 10  
The dominant giant gets nerfed.

Tidalgrasp  
Cooldown 3 → 3.5  
This should make it so building an aqualith makes sense.

Hawkista  
Cost 4 → 5

Stonk Stripes  
Cost 3 → 4  
This one might be weird, a money making cosmion getting more expensive? But it is the number 1 performing cosmion and even in builds that reach endgame, we can see multiple—which we shouldn’t.

Ifry  
Cost 9 → 10

Dorangutan  
Cooldown 4.5 → 6  
We know this change is huge but if you saw the stats you would agree with us.

Serenius  
Accuracy 100 → 90

Buffs

Riko  
Cost 3 → 2  
Water is by far the least played, and nerfing tidalgrasp isn’t going to help. This might push water to be too strong but we will see.

Volroost  
Damage 25–30 → 27–32  
Voltrex is good but Volroost isn’t.

Electric Mira  
Accuracy 90 → 100

ZEUS  
Cooldown 3.5 → 3  
Energy Cost 4 → 3  
Our worst performing unique, it should feel good to get them. This might be too much, we will be looking.

Iblis  
Energy Cost 4 → 0.5  
With a cooldown of 45 seconds, Iblis should NEVER miss due to energy reasons.

notes.title: NEODUEL v1.3.0 - Balance Patch & Live Servers
notes.notes:
Hey Duelists!

NEODUEL Live Servers are Back Online 🎉

WE ARE SO BACK!!!
After some issues with our server infrastructure, we had to turn NEODUEL into a single-player game, where the database was local. After separating from our previous publisher, Rogue Duck Interactive purchased all the rights to the game, and with their internal team, we got the servers back up!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/3cbe359669001dc8a1e3fa4f855feb39690d8991.png

Learn more: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2693940/view/525342544971695923

---

It has been a while and I missed making a patch and also a patch notes. Our goal for this patch is go safe while making unavaible units more avaible. Enjoy!

🔼 Buffs

Dorogun  
Crit Change: [strike]%0[/strike] → %20  
A little crit chance for that big hits, this dragon needs some love too; north of Swamp needs some love but they will get it in next patches.

Electric Mira  
Stamina Cost: [strike]1.5[/strike] → 1  
Electrocute has been scary for a while so we kept Electric Mira in check, but I guess it’s been too long in the shadows.

n30 c0sm10n  
Stamina Cost: [strike]2.5[/strike] → 2  
Accuracy: [strike]90[/strike] → 100  
Damage: [strike]8-11[/strike] → 9-12  
This is a cosmion we thought would be amazing, but never clicked with anyone. Maybe these buffs will make us see some N30 builds.

Capcop  
Cooldown: [strike]3[/strike] → 2.5  
Stamina: [strike]2[/strike] → 1.5  
Almost the same issue with N30; Capcop has big potential with knockback but is a little weak. This buff should make our pilot very happy.

Knod  
Stamina: [strike]3[/strike] → 2  
Damage: [strike]6-8[/strike] → 7-9  
Accuracy: [strike]90[/strike] → 100  
Same with the other two. We are hoping this is enough.

Konchi  
Crit Chance: [strike]%0[/strike] → %20  
Another underperforming elemental dragon. These small crit-chance buffs plus their stacking should make them able to clutch some wins.

Parry  
Price: [strike]8[/strike] → 6  
Parry was already very big; also being expensive made it a bad choice.

Ice QB  
Cooldown: [strike]3[/strike] → 2.5  
While reaching them is hard, obtaining them isn’t rewarding. It should be.

Bling Chiling  
Stamina: [strike]2.5[/strike] → 2  
Same note as Ice QB — reward should match the effort.

Runghai  
Crit Chance: [strike]%0[/strike] → %20  
Another underperforming elemental dragon, hoping this helps.

Hurdo  
Price: [strike]5[/strike] → 4  
Same thing with Hawkista.

Hawkista  
Price: [strike]6[/strike] → 4  
While it sounds amazing on paper, being hard to use makes Hawkista very difficult. This drop in price should help.

Agartha  
Crit Chance: [strike]%10[/strike] → %30  
Crit Damage: [strike]%150[/strike] → %200  
A unique cosmion, and almost weaker than some legendaries — should feel much better now.

Firefist  
Damage: [strike]10-13[/strike] → 10-14  
While I did not want to buff fire units, Firefist did deserve one. Still, I did the smallest buff I could 🙂

Z E U S  
Crit Chance: [strike]%0[/strike] → %20  
Math says this cosmion is balanced — maybe even strong — yet it loses. Maybe we’ll see if this helps.

Water Mira  
Stamina Cost: [strike]1.5[/strike] → 1

🔽 Nerfs

Isvasal  
Cooldown: [strike]7[/strike] → 8  
Very strong and winning too much, even more than rogueduck. This should help balance that.

Omnicore & Demoncore  
Price: [strike]11[/strike] → 12  
Top picks, always bought. Raising the price should make them more of a strategic choice.

Dorangutan  
Cooldown: [strike]4[/strike] → 4.5  
Another popular and winning unit. Small nerf to let others shine.

Houshan  
Cooldown: [strike]4.5[/strike] → 5  
While other dragons got buffs, this fiery one got a small nerf.

Porgur  
No changes — just letting you know this is by far the most balanced cosmion we have.

➕ Other Changes

• Live Servers are BACK ONLINE!  
• Codex element filter works better  
• 2 more gold in stages 1, 3, and 7 (6 total)  
Crafting a board is expensive, and that was killing some excitement. We're giving more gold to help ease that.

🐛 Bug Fixes

• Fixed some achievement bugs.

notes.title: NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters: The "So much content it should be a remaster" Update
notes.notes:
Happy holiday season Duelists!​ We're thrilled to announce the launch of NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters’ the "So much content it should be a remaster" major update. This follows November’s “Swamp” update, a major content drop for the highly-rated PvP auto-battler blending monster taming with strategic inventory management, from the Turkish indie duo of Rogue Duck Interactive and DiceHit Games. 

The Swamp Update (v1.1), released November 27th, introduced a fresh new fusion Element created by merging Nature and Water elements, with over 10 upgrades and Cosmions empowered by that same muddy power, alongside reworked Haste buff and Clumsy debuff. With the "So much content it should be a remaster" major update, NeoDuel continues to evolve by adding over 20 QoL updates ranging from UI changes to better user experience, brand new Steam Community items, and finally, a singleplayer mode, offering Duelists the space to refine their strategies, learn elemental counters, and take on curated challenges without affecting Elo ranks. 

On top of all, to celebrate this major update and the Steam Winter Sales, we're putting NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters on a 30% discount, just in time to treat your friends our game before the holiday break (prices are regionally adjusted, check your local store for exact pricing below). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693940/NEODUEL_Backpack_Monsters/ 

There's a lot to cover in this update, so grab a drink, and let's get to it: 

NEW CONTENT FOR THE GAME:

Singleplayer Challenges: A Community Favourite

With the arrival of Swamp, NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters also introduce a highly requested feature: single-player challenges. Duelists willing to learn the ropes, practice or even challenge themselves will be able to do so without losing any Elo ranks. The single player challenges bring a set of predefined Elemental “riddles” or "puzzles" where you must tackle a single run against a series of singular elemental themed builds, with more themed challenges to be added throughout the year. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/e981e677b69d20bceea5c7da88e2c89772706c3a.gif

Each challenge will include both a Normal mode, perfect for practicing, and a Harder version, designed for veteran Duelists. Upon completion, Duelists will be able to adorn an elemental challenge completion player card themed after the Element they've won, showing off their accomplishments.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/186816e42bf2195a2c7ab436d16a3784beb1b490.jpg

We've had lots of fun designing these challenges, full of pop culture and even meme references, and maybe some jokes that certain NeoDuel veterans will get. In any case, it's a fun yet challenging experience for solo duelists, and completely free of charge for all players. 

Steam Community items now available in Steam

Celebrate this update with the launch of NeoDuel five trading cards, connected to our main core elements - Neutral, Fire, Air, Nature, Water, Electricity - combined with the ultimate Evolution form of its corresponding starter Cosmions. As you play, you may earn those cards, which will ultimately unlock profile badges (themed after the 5 highest Elo ranks in the game), and even emoticons and profile backgrounds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/4d3c634058e40f6fc4612bf508974880055970af.png

QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES

This major update also adds to the range of new QoL updates, features, and balancing, including the following highlights: 


 New duelist avatars themed after the Air and Water Elements, DiceHit and Rogue Duck dev team 
 Custom name tags, 10 in total based on the singleplayer challenges (Air, Water, Electric, Fire and Nature)
 Refined Cosmions: balancing tweaks for better gameplay
 A new upgrade slot so you can pick out of 4 options instead of 3
 Enhanced Tutorial: Guidance for overtime mechanics and a new onboarding process
 New Tooltip adding much more details and readability to the stats, evolutions, fusions and changes in the game
 Stats Live Calculations: Real-time buff and nerfs stat displays in the shop for better strategy and planning
 Upgrade Screen & Customization Shop UI
 New Buff/Debuff Effects & Avatar Animations
 Polished Main Menu Assets

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/7798963ba6458aaeea46079680ab5f6800a6ef17.png

COSMION & UPGRADE BALANCING AND CHANGES

While the game has been quite solid in terms of balancing, based on almost a month of monitoring, we did find some little tweaks to push. The majority of it is mainly to give you some incentives to pick some of the least used Cosmions like n30 c0sm10n or even Belestra.  

AIR BASED COSMION

 Air Khepre and Khepira: Cooldown reduced from 4 to 2.5.


ELECTRIC BASED COSMION

 Belestra [REWORK]: Previous passive removed, and now each time Belestra deals damage, it gains 1 strength
 Wasbuzz: Critical hit chance upped from 20% to 30%.
 Z.E.U.S.: Added extra 10% critical chance stat.
 Tokmak: Energey cost reduced from 3 to 2.5.


NATURE BASED COSMION

 Rockeon: Damage range upped from 15-18 to 16-20.


NEUTRAL BASED COSMION

 n30 c0sm10n: Damage range upped from 7-9 to 8-11.
 Knod: Damage range upped from 5-6 to 6-8.


SWAMP BASED COSMION

 Squelcho: Energy cost reduced from 3 to 2.


WATER BASED COSMION

 Artwo: Energy cost reduced from 3 to 2.
 Serenius: Link effect upped from 5 to now 10 Flow


CHANGES TO UPGRADES

 Rook Upgrade: Reduced value of shield to 50% from 100%.


BUGFIXES AND KNOWN ISSUES


Steam Deck bugs - KNOWN ISSUE : Steam Deck running on Linux means that lots of those OS bugs are affecting Neoduel "on the go". Expect to see black bar in places where some animations are not loading correctly, and there's small instances of cloud save not working as intended, creating a different instance of your save on the machine. We're currently investigating a fix.
Achievements - KNOWN ISSUE : We received small reports of certain complex achievements like "Fusion Complete" are not triggering upon completion. We're currently investigating a fix but require more data so don't hesitate to open a support ticket on Discord.


That’s it for now Duelists! We’ll be constantly monitoring how you will be playing this new version of the game, before taking a short break for the holidays. From our small but dedicated dev team, our publisher and other partners, we would like to thank you all for supporting us! 

Until then, for the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem.

notes.title: NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters - V1.1: The Swamp and Singleplayer Challenges Update
notes.notes:
Brace yourselves for new Duels! 

We're excited to announce the first major free update to NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters (currently rated Highly Positive on Steam), our exciting PvP auto-battler that combines strategic inventory management with monster taming elements. 

This update, titled “The Swamp Update” (version 1.1), is now live on Steam and introduces a fresh new fusion Element by the same name, created by merging Nature and Water elements and on top of that we've done the prework on a bunch of new feature coming in the coming months including a soon™ to be released singleplayer challenges for all solo Duelists. Perfect timing as we push today a  30% discount promotion in celebration of this major patch and Steam Autumn Sales... We guess it's perfect timing to gift this game to your friends now before the holidays (prices are regionally adjusted, check your local store for exact pricing below). 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2693940/NEODUEL_Backpack_Monsters/ 

We also wanted to introduce a Custom PvP mode in this updates (as mentioned in V1.0.97 patch notes), but due to some IP-based restrictions in certain countries, we've decided to push that feature to a later date instead of preventing some nations from being able to use it. The good thing is that the system is ready, and just requires our network infrastructure to find a solution around those IP restrictions. 

In any case, there's a lot to cover in this update, and like all kinds of Swamp parties, they always toad-ally fun. So without further pondering around let's get to it: 

NEW CONTENT FOR THE GAME:

A slippery element: Dance to the “algae” groove of the Swamp Element

This major V1.1 update of NeoDuel will feature the second of our four major and free content update revolving around the new gameplay mechanic addition known as Elemental fusion. After Ice, we're introducing the power of the Swamp, an elemental power from the fusion of Water and Nature which brings a reworked version of the Haste buff and Clumsy debuff. Similar to previous blog post, we figured we'd list all of the new Cosmions which most of them rely on a fusion (you can see them visually under this list in order from right to left): 


 Swamp Essence: only two kind exist (Rare and Epic) with the Rare one being the results of a fusion between Rare Water and Nature Essences. Fuse two of those to obtain an Epic Swamp Essence.
 Swamp Slimi: The results of a fusion of Water and Nature Slimi.
 Axomuddy: Kind of look like the known walking catfish, this Cosmion is the fusion Duopon and Sugeko.
 Bog Klood: Fuse an Water Klood with a Rare Nature Essence, or alternatively an Acid Klood with Rare Water Essence.
 Squelcho: The results of fusing Arthur with an Epic Nature Essence.
 Orhan: Fuse Cemil with a Rare Nature Essence and you get this muddy attacker. 
 Dorogun: The Swamp dragon is the result of Bradragon with a Rare Swamp Essence.
 Iblis: This is the mighty triple fusion of Cemil, Suat and Orhan, merging into this Neutral grim reaper. 
 Mosscream: The fusion of a Domi and Duopon.
 Drenchnaut: This mud turtle is the fusion result of Strutwahl and a Rare Nature Essence.
 Hagartha: This super-unique Cosmion themed after an iconic Witch of the swamps can only be obtained through the "Terror of the Swamp" shop Upgrade as a reward.
 Artwo: While not a Swamp Cosmion, this Water "upgraded" version of Arthur was necessary for the meta. Fuse Arthur with an Epic Water Essence to obtain this critter.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/a6c9de615c15e6089c89efb727bc72e0b02653ca.png

Some slippery Upgrades! 

Over the past two months since the launch, we've added 30 new upgrades in the game, ranging from elemental keyword counters to rare game-changing alterations, and that now reaches the range of close to 200 in total. While, most upgrades have been rebalanced based on feedback from Duelists, we decided to tone down on the drop new upgrades for this version (as the pool is getting huge), and so we have 7 starting Swamp themed one, focusing mostly . As for the keywords, we've redesigned how Haste and Clumsy works:


 Haste: Your caster and defender Cosmions trigger 3% faster
 Clumsy: Opponents' caster and defender Cosmions trigger 3% slower


While it seems like the same as before, Haste and Clumsy were actually affecting all Cosmions, and thus now they're focused more around the current changes from Swamp, having so many Defenders and Casters added to the game.

QUALITY OF LIFE UPDATES

This major update also adds a range of new and previously released QoL updates, features and balancing that were added since the launch on September 30th, including the following highlights: 


 Redesigned menu and player card [NEW]: A revised version of the main page UI has been enhanced, featuring a rework on the player card with your stats implemented, with a clearer customization button to set up your avatar.
 Tutorial for newcommers [NEW]: While working on a the singleplayer challenges, we were inspired to revise our previous tutorial experience. This new version is a better onboarding system, as it doesn't pair you against another player's board, but rather a preset challenge for you to learn the ropes of the game, and learn from the mistake of those other boards. 
 Ice Elementals: Introduction of Ice elementals alongside 13 new Cosmions. 
 New PvP practice mode: After completing a full game run, generate a build code to share and compare your setup against a friend's opponent. 
 New Upgrades: Over 30 new upgrades are available in the game, ranging from elemental keyword counters to rare game-changing alterations. Most upgrades have been rebalanced based on feedback from Duelists. 
 Complete Codex: A comprehensive Codex that explains all game mechanics, includes a full list of Cosmions, fusion recipes, and fun flavor text for our cosmic critters. 
 Quality of Life (QoL) updates: new icon designs, optimized UI, visual changes, keyboard shortcuts, fusion lock, and a lot more.


That’s it for now Duelists, we've taken enough of your time, go and climb the ranks! We’ll be constantly monitoring this week stability of the builds, meta and other live aspect of the game, to make sure the game is perfect. From our small but dedicated dev team, our publisher and other partners, we would like to thank you all for supporting us in this launch! 

Until then, for the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem.

notes.title: NeoDuel: Patch Notes (Version 1.0.97)
notes.notes:
Salutations, Duelists! As of today, November 14th, 2024, a new patch has gone live for NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters. To experience the most recent and up to date build of NeoDuel on Steam, make sure you update your game. Here's what to expect in this patch note:

NEW UPCOMING FEATURES

While this is not technically getting implemented today, the patch does prepare the ground work for the game to host a new feature we had in mind for a while which is PvP custom games. While we have the casual mode to let Duelists do practice runs without fear of losing any Elo ranks, we always wanted to allow everyone to play against a specific build from a friend, without having to redo the game design. After all, this is an asynchronous multiplayer game, so you're not effectively fighting other backpacks live, so we had to find a different approach to the PvP custom game mode. That said, coming next week, we're going to launch that mode if it all goes well, and we'll explain a bit more how it works.

On another note, our development on the Swamp Update (version 1.1) progress is going well, and we're definitely hitting our deadline of launching around the end of this year. In the meantime, we figured we'd reveal some of our early sketches of the Swamp Cosmions as a teaser, and would love to hear from you Duelists what you think these two critters' names are.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/95ef4dda3fe3d05edc85a5f00eeba176b613a554.png

COSMION & ESSENCE BALANCING AND CHANGES

In this patch the balancing is solely focused on the Fire Element. We had to give it a little additional discouragement because, in spite of all the earlier nerfs, Fire is still the most common element. As you can see, it mostly targets the Flinter spamming builds' power buildings and makes adjustments to Houshan, the popular Fire dragon, with minor hits to Blazeroll and Matchiro.

FIRE BASED COSMION


 Flinter: Upped price in shop from 4 to 5
 Matchiro: Base damage range lowered from 3-6 to 3-5.
 Blazeroll: Upped price in shop from 4 to 5.
 Houshan: Cooldown upped from 4 to 4.5.


DRAGON ARCHETYPE COSMION


 Baby Dragon: Accuracy reduced from 80 to 50


Developer’s Notes:  The reason for this nerf is the newly discovered Baby Dragon Attacker build paired with Dragon Scales Upgrade. While I do think it's an interesting buildcraft, it should not be this strong. If you are going for it, better have some Clarity now!

BUGFIXES AND KNOWN ISSUES


Steam Deck bugs - KNOWN ISSUE : Steam Deck running on Linux means that lots of those OS bugs are affecting Neoduel "on the go". Expect to see black bar in places where some animations are not loading correctly, and there's small instances of cloud save not working as intended, creating a different instance of your save on the machine. We're currently investigating a fix.
Achievements - KNOWN ISSUE : We received small reports of certain complex achievements like "Fusion Complete" are not triggering upon completion. We're currently investigating a fix but require more data so don't hesitate to open a support ticket on Discord.


For the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem. Till then, keep on dueling, and good luck!

notes.title: NeoDuel: Patch Notes (Version 1.0.96) - The Big Upgrade Patch!
notes.notes:
Salutations, Duelists! As of today, November 7th, 2024, a new patch has gone live for NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters. To experience the most recent and up to date build of NeoDuel on Steam, make sure you update your game. Here's what to expect in this patch note:

THE BIG UPGRADE PATCH

DID SOMEONE SAY MAWR UPGRADES!? Yes indeed, and that brings a staggering amount of almost 160 Upgrades in the game with today's 13 new additional Upgrades. The new batch is just adds some missing pieces to the puzzle, and here's the full list including in order from left to right. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/d36b290b48736b9315fc1b64a7ca629ab75dd9c2.png

 David (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Take 30% maximum health damage and gain 20% damage.
 Goliath (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Gain shield equal to 25% of your max health and lose 5% damage.
 Regen of the Colossus (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Every second, gain 1,5% of your maximum Health.
 Roll of the dice (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Cosmions have 10% chance of not consuming Energy.
 SHIELDS UP 1 (available in stage 1): At start, gain 40 Shield.
 SHIELDS UP 2 (available in stage 2): At start, gain 90 Shield.
 SHIELDS UP 3 (available in stage 3): At start, gain 150 Shield.
 Stop the Bleeding (available in stage 1 and 2): For every loss you have, gain 2 Toughness.
 Strength from numbers (available in stage 1 and 2): For every Cosmion you have, deal 1% more damage.
 Tough Shell (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): For every Defender you have, gain 1 Toughness.
 Slimi packet 1 (available in stage 1): Your Slimis now have 4 second cooldown instead of one time effect, gain 2 Slimis.
 Slimi packet 2 (available in stage 2): Your Slimis now have 4 second cooldown instead of one time effect, gain 4 Slimis.
 ANOTHER ONE? (available in stage 2): Gain a Rogueduck, lose everything you have.

Developer’s Notes:  With this update, you will realize that the Upgrade selection pool is getting bigger, and we won't stop there. When a pool gets this big, it can be very hard to find the Upgrades you are looking for in the long run. While we don't want players to be forced into playing a specific build every time, we also do not want Duelists to NEVER play their dream composition. In a near future patch, we are thinking of a QoL update which will further make the entire Upgrade selection feel good and reliable.

This patch is also focused on a rebalancing of Neoduel's Upgrades, with a plethora of changes mostly on a granular level in terms of stats, based on now one full month of Duelist data. That ranges from how many times certain Upgrades or Cosmions were picked in the shop, and pair it with current win streak and overall success rate. We hope that the following rebalanced upgrades will incite some new build crafting juice:

 Adrenaline Boost (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Once per duel, when you are below 25% Health, gain Shield equal to the 25%->20% of your maximum Health.
 Better Than Nothing 1 (available in stage 1): Each lose gives 4->5 additional coins.
 Better Than Nothing 2 (available in stage 2): Each lose gives 6->8 additional coins.
 Better Than Nothing 3 (available in stage 3): Each lose gives 8->10 additional coins.
 Blood Pact (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Lose 20%->30 of your Health but gain 5-6 Strengthen.
 Blood Pact (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Your Cosmions deal more damage according to your opponent's missing health (1%-40%->30%, capped at 40%->30% Health).
 Cheap Tactics (available in stage 1 and 2): Common and Rare Cosmions trigger 35% faster.
 Corrosive Acid (available in stage 1 and 2): Acid now also damages the opponent Health. Acid now deals %25 less damage.
 Defense of Many (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): Gain 8->7 Shield per Cosmion you have.
 Earthen Armor (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): Gain 5->7 Toughness.
 Elemental Synergy (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): Cosmions from your most used element have additional 30%->20% Cooldown Reduction.
 Energized! 1 (available in stage 1): Gain 5->6 Energize.
 Energized! 2 (available in stage 2): Gain 7->9 Energize.
 Energized! 2 (available in stage 2): Gain 10->12 Energize.
 F.A.S.T. (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): Gain 7->5 Haste.
 FireStarter 1 (available in stage 1): Inflict 5->4 Burn.
 FireStarter 2 (available in stage 2): Inflict 10->8 Burn.
 FireStarter 3 (available in stage 3): Inflict 15->12 Burn.
 FlowMaster 1 (available in stage 1): Gain 10->15 Flow.
 FlowMaster 3 (available in stage 3): Gain 30->25 Flow.
 Greedy Dragon 1 (available in stage 1): Gain 10->8 Coins.
 Greedy Dragon 2 (available in stage 2): Gain 15->12 Coins.
 Greedy Dragon 3 (available in stage 3): Gain 20->16 Coins.
 Harmonic Resonance (available in stage 2 and 3): If you have equal number of Fire and Water Cosmions, gain 45->50 Flow and inflict 15 Burn.
 Icy Protection (available in stage 1,2 and 3): Triggering Frostbite also gives 25->20 Shield.
 Icy Veins (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): For every Ice Cosmion you have, inflict 2->3 Frostbite  at start.
 Jitterz (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): Boost your Energy regeneration rate by 40%->30%.
 Last Breath (available in stage 2 and 3): When you are below 40%->30% Health, Attacker Cosmions gain 100% Critical Chance.
 Less is More (available in stage 1, 2 and 3): If you have less Cosmions than your opponent, gain 10->12 Toughness.
 Like the Wind 1 (available in stage 1): Gain 5->6 Clarity.
 Like the Wind 2 (available in stage 2): Gain 7->9 Clarity.
 Like the Wind 3 (available in stage 3): Gain 10->12 Clarity.

notes.title: NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters – One Month Anniversary Celebration Blog and Update
notes.notes:
Happy 1-month anniversary to all Dueslists! 

In today's dev blog, we're looking forward to the future after one month of launch. What were the highlights so far, some fun stats about our Duelist's performance, as well as to what to expect for the future of Neoduel: Backpack Monsters.

Despite some of bugs and issues in the launch week, we are generally pleased with how the release went, and for that we'd want to take this time to thank everyone from your Duelists to our dev team and publishing partners. Everyone involved and our community has been incredibly receptive and transparent with questions, concerns, and recommendations, and we have taken everything on board which has shaped the future of the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/ca2dc276e3c0cf7d68ae385bb413f6396195b929.jpg

THE 1-MONTH LAUNCH ANNIVERSARY RECAP:

Since the launch on September 30th, we've released a healthy spread of patches both fixing key issues, but also adding new features, Cosmions, Upgrades and much more. In case you missed the news, here's the recap:


New Fusion Element and Cosmions: added on launch day, the Ice element brought a change to the meta for those that have been with us since the early testing and demo days. We're really glad people are finding some fun synergies with Ice Cosmions and making use of the Frostbite keywords. Fun fact, Ice Cosmions were the least changed in terms of stats and effect since the launch.
Complete Codex: Throughout the month, we've updated and improved the Codex adding a bunch of new features to help newcomers and even veterans familiarize themselves with as much of the game as they can. Accessible from the main menu as well as during games, the Codex explains all game mechanics, features a full list of all Cosmions, Fusion recipe lists, as well as some fun flavor text for our cosmic critters.
New Cosmions!: While the launch date Ice Cosmion drops upped the full roster by 13 new creatures, we also introduced a new Pedro evolution, a Duopon fusion and a new neutral Cosmion known as Naci. The latter might seem cute, but he's a good counter to those Frostbite builds.
New Game Mode The main core mode of the game is a ranked run where your performance affects your daily, weekly and all-time elo standing and rank. We've introduced recently a Casual version of that mode, to make sure people had a way to practice without the fear of dropping that much in Elo rank.
So many QoL updates!: This is where our Neoduel community really shined, and we'd like to thank them once more for their input. Throughout this past month, their feedback helped us optimize some features, and we've introduced new icon designs, optimized UI, lots of visual changes, keyboard shortcuts, fusion lock, and so much more.


THE NEXT MILESTONE UPDATE: ENTER THE DEPTHS OF THE SWAMP

Now what we've done this recap, we've been working on our next milestone patch, set for launch in November and it's going be to one where Duelist will need to master the art of hostile environment survival: Swamp.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/3682b4365dc9a3a00b108f6582a107702d71046f.png

While we originally planned to have Lava as our next Fusion Element in our roadmap, the current meta with our players had us change it to Swamp. We won't delve that much into the Element for now and its associated keyword, but know that this decision of a change is better for the health of the current builds. Expect new themed Cosmions, Upgrades, and some other bigger surprises for our version 1.1 of the game. 

THE 1-MONTH LAUNCH UPDATE: AVAILABLE TODAY FOR FREE!

Thursdays are our usual weekly update days, and we figured in honor of one month celebration - and Halloween - to give you some free treats:


FRESH NEW UPGRADES

Pethor's release 2 weeks ago might have opened the flood gate on our upgrade factory, and 
we're introducing today more than 10 new upgrades (12 to be exact) with this update. They're pretty much fun, and most are focused on defending yourselves from specific Elemental keywords, while other add some new gameplay mechanics like some unique Zones. Here's the full list and their icons (from left to right in order):

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/c8a1c039c17ce1ac959bd1a1dbe053c0ca5c3ad8.png


 Base Armor (available in stage 2 and 3): You get 40% less damage from Acid
 Elephant Skin (available in stage 2 and 3): You get 40% less damage from Spike
 Iron Wool Jacket (available in stage 2 and 3): You get 30% less damage from Burn
 Water Repellant (available in stage 2 and 3): Opponent's Water Cosmions trigger 30% slower
 Rubber Shoes (available in stage 2 and 3): Electrocute stuns you for half the normal value (0.5 instead of 1 second).
 Not so fast, bardner (available in stage 2 and 3): Inflict 1 Clumsy for every 3 Haste your opponent gains. 
 Electrical Shield (available in all stages): Every time you trigger Electrocute, gain 20 value of shield.
 Butterfly Effect (available in stage 1 and 2): Your Plinns now have 300% Critical Damage and you also gain 2 additional Plinns.
 Dragonic Armor(available in stage 1): For every dragon you have, gain 50 Shield at start.
 TURBO matchiroS (available in stage 1): Matchiros now consumes 0 Energy and you also gain 2 Matchiros.
 Kloody Skies (available in stage 1 and 2): Your Kloods trigger 1 second faster and you also gain 2 Kloods.
 I am an Economist (available in stage 1): Your Stonks Stripes and Protecc gives 1 additional coin and gain 2 Stonks Stripes.


As usual, don't forget to check out the Codex for all these new upgrades, or to refresh your memory on certain mechanics. 

CODEX FILTERING SYSTEM

A much requested feature by our Duelists, but one that was a bit harder than expected for us. Say goodbye to endless scrolling in the Codex to find a specific Cosmion to see its stats, effects or refresh your memory. We've added a simple filter system where you can now search by Elements, to quickly see only Ice Cosmions and Essences for example.


BONUS: FUN STATS!

We thought to end this dev blog with some interesting stats about this one month of launch. I'm sure you're eager to discover things like which Cosmion or Upgrade is the most used, how many players have done flawless runs and other things. 


 The most recuring win/loss ratio in a single run is 6 to 5. About 9% of the entire player base finish their run with this score.
 Only 0.25% of our player base is above the 7000 Elo rank. Talk about le Slimi du Slimi!
 Elemental Synergy is by far the most popular Upgrade picked in the Shop! 
 So many Duopon picked, BUT it ranks 10th out of 10 most used Cosmions. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/036d374c61dd8899489f406c5c360fc401821040.jpg

BUGFIXES AND KNOWN ISSUES


Casual mode loop bug: Fixed a rare bug when after losing a casual game, you sometimes had the option to continue, resulting in a loop where you could play your final fifth try infinitely if you wanted to (you could still give up).
Steam Deck bugs - KNOWN ISSUE : Steam Deck running on Linux means that lots of those OS bugs are affecting Neoduel "on the go". Expect to see black bar in places where some animations are not loading correctly, and there's small instances of cloud save not working as intended, creating a different instance of your save on the machine. We're currently investigating a fix.
Achievements - KNOWN ISSUE : We recieved small reports of certain complex achievements like "Fusion Complete" are not triggering upon completion. We're currently investigating a fix but require more data so don't hesitate to open a support ticket on Discord.


That’s it for now Duelists! From our small but dedicated dev team, our publishers and other partners, we would like to thank you all for supporting us in this launch, and sticking around to support and help us. 

Until then, for the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem.

COSMION & ESSENCE BALANCING AND CHANGES

This patch SHOULD make the game feel better on that front, paired with some other stat changes to make sure nothing is too strong or weak. NEW FEATURE:

Refreshed Keyboard Shortcuts: With the fusion lock feature we added last week, some of our players who got used to right click to drop Cosmions into the storage voiced their need for new shortcuts. That's why we're bringing it back to not break your gaming instinct and introduce some new ones which are: 


 C -> Open the Codex
 K -> Drop everything from backpack! That includes Cosmion, Zones, and anything you can stash. 
 F -> Reroll the store offerings
 R -> Rotate held Cosmion, Zones, etc. 
 Q or Right Click -> Drop the highlighted Cosmion into storage OR reserve shop offering.
 E or mouse scroll button -> Fusion Lock
 M -> Sell highlighted Cosmions, Zones, Essence. 
 Space -> Start Duel
 Arrow keys or WASD -> Acts like a D-pad and moves the entire board


BUGFIXES


 Steam cloud save system improvements: Throughout the launch week, some players had issues with Steam cloud saves due to tightened security and permission settings. This cause players to have different instances of their game progress on different platform (such as PC vs Steam Deck). We've optimized how cloud save is handled now, and things should work as smooth as a butter. 
 Double essence fusion/evolution bugs: Fixed an issue where some fusions wouldn't work as intended when positioning two Essences next to each other while linked to their needed Cosmion. While we couldn't replicate the issue in our playtest, our patch should address that, but do let us know if you encounter this again.


COSMION & ESSENCE BALANCING AND CHANGES

While we're still cooking the full balance patch based on our data from last week and this coming one, we've realized one thing: Fire builds are prevalent. Even though not the strongest builds in terms of success rate, it's still the most players. Therefore we are nerfing some of the best performing fire Cosmions just a bit, while buffing a tad bit some lesser used evolved and fusion ones.

ELECTRICITY BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Chirvolt: Reduced energy consumption from 3 to 2
 Volroost: Reduced energy consumption from 6 to 4
 Voltrex: Reduced energy consumption from 8 to 5


Developer’s Notes:  Chrivolt is an adorable Electric starter Cosmion, but we realized that its current energy consumption and its evolutionary path was too high. So we tweaked them down.

FIRE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Houshan : Cooldown upped from 3 to 3.5
 Firefist : Damage range reduced from 10-15 to 10-13


ICE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Cryo Sugeko: Changed fusion recipe form Sugeko + Common Air Essence to now Sugeko + Rare Ice Essence.


Developer’s Notes:  Ice is meant to feel strong as an element as it requires stacking, but Cryo Sugeko is the most used one as it was only requiring a Common Air Essence to evolve it. So we decided to tone it down by making its evolution more difficult, requiring now a Rare Ice Essence.

NATURE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Duopon: Price in shop upped from from 3 to 4.


Developer’s Notes:  Duopon is performing a little too well for a low cost Cosmion. It is very good for links as well as early game sustain, but at this price IN THIS ECONOMY? That's just a steal.

WATER BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Serenius: Reduced energy consumption from 6 to 4. Upped Damage range from 25-30 to 30-35.


Developer’s Notes:  Arguably the worst performing Cosmion according to our data, we've decided to give it some love to incite you all to try it, especially considering its on hit effect of applying 2 Fog and creating 2 Flow.

notes.title: NeoDuel: Backpack Monster - Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Greetings Duelists! 

My name is Dora Özsoy, one of the lead Producers on NeoDuel from Rogue Duck Interactive, known for games like Cardboard Town and recently launched Dice & Fold. In case you missed it, we revealed our official launch date, set now for 30th of September 2024, as announced via a fresh new trailer via IGN which you can watch below. The game will be made available for the price of $11.99 with a launch discount of 20% (rounding to roughly $9.50), with lower regional pricing for a handful of markets. Don’t forget to help us out by sharing the Launch Reveal trailer on social media, to get the word out to as many potential future Duelists as possible. 

[previewyoutube=xf1LR2mEvhw;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re super excited to finally launch the game after months of work, based on a long list of feedback, surveys and playthrough of the demo from our community.  While we spoke about the launch content update in the 0.9.0 Patch Notes, we’re glad to share that pretty much everything planned is going according to plan, including a reworked onboarding for newcomers, technical optimization, the Cosmodex and some new gameplay mechanics including the arrival of fusionable elements starting with Ice (blending Water and Air together). In that sense, we’re going to keep the demo for a few days, then it will be retired from the Steam store so get your Duels going until then (official date will be shared at a later stage). 

The remaining days will be needed for the last polishing touch on the game before the release, such as finishing up tweaks on localization of our 11 supported languages (English, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified & Traditional Chinese), as well as some scheduled quality assurance work. This will provide us plenty of time to concentrate on gameplay refinement, bug repairs, optimization, and interface enhancements as well. 
For the time being, I figured I’ll give you a glimpse of all that is to be expected in the full release of NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters. 

CLARITY OF GAMEPLAY AND UI FEATURES:

Game Tutorial
Remember that tutorial you weren’t really a fan of? Maybe it was too simplistic to help anyone with the game, or lacked details to appeal to new Duelists, so we changed things up. Once you play NeoDuel for the first time, your first run of games will feature on-screen prompts guiding you through the Duel, explaining the basics of the inventory management, monster-tamer and auto-battling aspect of the game. This decision was made after a constant data analysis of the current player base not making use of the dedicated tutorial in the game.

The Cosmodex (name pending)
While we didn’t decide on a fancy name for our Cosmion Index feature in NeoDuel, it will have everything you need to educate yourself on the current launch list of over 175 Cosmions and Elemental essences, but also how to acquire those Evolved and Fused Cosmions. Other than that, expect some small, animated guides as well on certain game mechanics, that could also be a refresher for those of you that haven’t played the demo for a while. 

NEW CONTENT FOR THE GAME:

The Ice Update: Rise of the Cosmion… Walkers?

As part of our free content roadmap, the full release of NeoDuel will introduce our first gameplay mechanic addition known as Elemental fusion: blend the power of Air and Water to create a new Element – Ice – to freeze your opponent in the arena. In the process, new Cosmion evolutions and fusions will emerge, harnessing the power of ice, adding more than 13 new critters to the Cosmodex. As with other Elemental types, most Ice Cosmions will have a new “keyword” associated to them which is Frostbite. It requires Duelists to stack 10 values of that Frostbite, which will trigger a 50 HP damage wave of chilling power. Throughout the coming year, 3 more Elemental fusions will launch with free major updates including Lava, Swamp and Storm. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/4dc25f71335d86bf5d00740cc2fba964350edd84.jpg
from left to right, Icatis, Bling Chling and Fubuki.

Here’s couple of examples to know what to expect from these frosty Cosmions:


 Bling Chling: this Cosmion might be cute, but his rhymes are sharper than icicles. Its trigger effect is to inflict 5 Frostbite, and a 4x Ice link will help the Cosmion gain 2 damage.
 Icatis: The Ice evolution of Abatis is themed like a certain winter celebration. After each Frostbite blast, you gain 20 shield.
 Fubuki: What if Fanfox embraced the power of Okami? A master of the chill winds, Fubuki inflicts one stack of Frostbite for every enemy miss. Upon a 5-level Ice link, it will inflict 1 fog at start.

There’s many more to come, and we can’t wait to see what you Duelists might do to harness Ice. 

Voice over announcers: Let’s get ready to rumble!

We know, that’s a bit of a surprise! NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters will now feature voice overs in two languages, mainly Turkish and English, specifically for the Arena announcers to bring these Duels to life. Nick Atlas, known for his roles in Mika and the Witch’s Mountain, Dune Spice Wars and Cultic, will be your English announcer, while Zeynep Önen will take the same role for the Turkish language. The latter is known for her work in numerous televised animation work in Turkey, including Niloya, Tay and Sagu & Pagu.  

That’s it for now Duelists! We’ll be hard at work in the coming weeks to get ready for the launch, and a potential day one update with some balancing updates and a couple of additional surprises. Until then, for the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem. Till then, keep on dueling, and good luck!

notes.title: NeoDuel: Demo Patch Notes (Version 0.9.0) - Wholesome Edition
notes.notes:
Greetings Duelists!

Missed us? A few weeks ago, we planned to write a retrospective blog post, but after being included in this week's Wholesome Games Steam Celebration, we decided it would be preferable to concentrate on two things: finishing up some essential improvements that the community has requested, and sharing our recap.

As we prepare for the upcoming full launch in the upcoming season, let me set some expectations: our publishers, The 4 Winds Entertainment, and our development team, Rogue Duck Interactive and DiceHit Games, are committed to giving our community regular updates about the game, even in its demo form. So let's get started right away!

STEAM FEST RECAP AND THE STATE OF NEODUEL DEVELOPMENT

For the past couple of weeks since the end of the Steam Next Fest, we’ve had a mountain of data to analyze from demo players’ feedback, to suggestions in our official Discord channels, but also those that filled in the official game survey, and for that we would like to start this blog entry by thanking you all!

We learned a lot from player’s feedback, ranging from what most of you like, dislike, and what exactly the general consensus felt missing in a game like NeoDuel. On top of that, the Steam annual event helped us reach a whopping 15000 wishlists, and we can’t thank you enough for it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/7f27683f145704e52f0a8808b87a5ca5f721eafb.png

Also a small visual update: NeoDuel has a new logo! The new design is much clearer, and carries on the visual style of the Traditional & Simplified Chinese, Korean and Japanese versions as they are fully localized. We are particularly big fans of the little flairs added in certain letters to bring them more to the front. 

Now in the essence of transparency, we figured we share some of the highlights of what we learned mattered the most to our veteran and new Duelists:

[olist]
 General Gameplay and Mechanics: The keyword that is the most recurring in the feedback is simply “diversity” and “balancing”. While Duelists are enjoying the complexity of gameplay elements, fusions and evolutions of Cosmions, there’s a certain “build fatigue” where recurrent strategies are happening a bit too often especially at higher elo. That’s why our commitment to constant build balancing will carry on as it is, and in case you have missed it on our Steam page, one of the post-launch FREE content updates will be bringing a new gameplay mechanic: elemental fusion. In a nutshell, you’ll be able to blend the power of Air and Water to create a new Element known as Ice, to freeze your opponent in the arena. That’s the first of the 4 new elemental fusions planned as an example. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/e0cd31863341b8b2943348cfefd06d24fc8fa59c.jpg

 Cosmion Evolutions and Fusion Mechanics: One thing that Duelist pointed out is the lack of set knowledge about all this aspect of Cosmion power. So far, the majority have learned it through trial and error, and we’re working on a compendium that will feature a Cosmodex (a complete list of all Cosmions and their trigger/passive abilities), as well as fusion guides and a list of “starter” builds to get you going. Expect this closer to the full launch of the game, which will endorse the updated tutorial or onboarding experience for newcomers. 
 Technical Aspects of the game: Another big challenge as a developer is that our design of NeoDuel is biased to our constant involvement in its development. Listening to players has helped us realize that certain aspect of our game are rather crude, and we have identified couple of points that we are launching with this 0.9.0 update (AKA the Wholesome Patch today). This includes SFX for Cosmions and certain actions, Animations and VFX for multiple aspect of the game and localization into more languages. 
[/olist]

There’s much more as well, but we want to keep surprises for the full launch. The ultimate goal is to keep NeoDuel fresh from now until launch and onward, adding a broader variety of Cosmions and game elements, to refresh the game and provide new strategic options. 

THE WHOLESOME PATCH: VERSION 0.9.0 AVAILABLE NOW

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/83ed8d17c81efe746ddadb471d01a2b002e6d972.jpg

Today’s patch was catered specifically for our participation in the Wholesome Games Steam Celebration running from today until the 21st of August. This event is a cozy celebration and showcase of all video games that inspire optimism, joy, and introspection, and we thank them for hosting us. 

This new build is quite a big one, even bigger than the version that was prepared for Steam Next Fest, and we hope you like what you’ll see. Our team has been working very hard to update the meta with a ton of new features and content while keeping some of the best duelist builds available... But more balanced. 

NEW CONTENT FOR THE GAME:

New Languages: Hallo! Bonjour ! Hola! Olá! Privyet!

NeoDuel is a game that relies on a lot of reading, so not playing it in your native language might be hard for many Duelists. This update adds French, Spanish, German, Brazilian Portuguese, and Russian. The game thus expands its reach beyond the initial Turkish & English versions and already supported Traditional & Simplified Chinese, Korean and Japanese languages. Note that the current localization is not final and doesn't reflect the final product, so if you do find anything that seems out of context, don’t hesitate to share your feedback on our official Discord channel. 

SFX and VFX: call in the animators!

We took action after hearing you Duelists claim that this is our weakest area! A ton of idle animations for our favorite Duelist avatar, a dynamic health bar that brings the combat to life, and a ton of noises you'll hear while playing have all been included. We can't wait for you to see a ton more of it in the complete launch editions! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/53b6671a481a5cf083500e4190c9e8821edd9e60.gif

Enhanced Battle Log

Introduced in patch 0.7.1 back during Steam Next Fest, this feature was well received but felt like it could use some more… well, logs. We added in effects in the battle log as well, while changing its design for better clarity, and hopefully will be something you use more often. 

The BIG Upgrade update

This is a significant modification that will fundamentally alter how players interact. For those who don't know, Upgrades are modifiers that you can choose every few rounds to alter your strategy. An example of an upgrade would be to reduce the cost of fire cosmions. We added a ton of new Upgrades and modified nearly 90% of the existing ones, so be ready to be astonished. 

The fundamental justification is that, in the process of investigating balancing Upgrades, we discovered that, in order to truly make them enjoyable, we need to modify the system and remove the ones that are overused. This implies that as you advance, the Upgrades you receive after your third match will start off as somewhat "common" rarity Upgrades and will eventually scale to rarer, more potent ones. This adjustment will bring the flat value Upgrades into line with the percentage ones, improving their balance. Ultimately, we came to the realization that many of our improvements were not as enjoyable as previous ones, so we decided to embrace a chaotically joyous part of the new ones. 

New Cosmions Evolutions:

While we’re working on a bunch of new wyvern themed Cosmions that we might have teased on our official Twitter/X page, this update brings a new evolution for two of our favorite Cosmions: Mira and the duo Serena & Sparky.

The Serena & Sparky evolution is a fun design, where Sparky now becomes a rideable electric beast which Serena mounts in battle. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/b6957eed82933e64dcbee877dcf5a00d327ac458.png

The second one is for our cute yet super-diverse Cosmion Mira. While Mira was already rather jack of all trade fusion pick thanks to its ability to get enhanced to any Elemental power, its Epic evolution involves embracing another Cosmions called Khepre to make use of it as shield. We promise you, it’s an adMIRAble sight. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44786371/ca87d93fcc789cabec539810ce8d8d24785d6a8e.png

COSMION & ESSENCE BALANCING AND CHANGES

ELECTRIC BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Knod Cooldown upped from 1.75 to 2.5 Knod, and damage has been reduced from a range of from 4-7 to now 6-8
 Liskers rarity raised from Rare to Epic, and changed its link effect of gain +1 damage for linked Cosmions in every 4 active links rather than 3. 
 Nikola7 damage reduced 30 to 27 when triggered by Stun. 


Developer’s Notes: Bizzz… Spark…. While this patch is about all the other more “macro” changes we are focusing on, we just had to look at this particular combination which dominated the game since the Steam Next Fest build. The problem with this Knod/Liskers/Nikola7 combo is this: Knod does double attacks, Liskers gives attack damage per link which Knod doubles, and when you bring Nikola7 to the mix with 8 links its big burst match start trigger, then you’re pretty much unstoppable. When a player combined these 3 units, they halved the health of the opposing backpack in one burst, then  that was followed with a quick double attack from Knod to end the Duel. So our reasoning was to first keep the intended attack amplifiers abilities of Knod, but raising its cooldown. Then when looking at Liskers, we realized its original design concept was meant at a time where the abilities for multiple links was much lower. We figured we should increase its link number, but upping its rarity to Epic to enforce scarcity in the shop. Finally for Nikola7, its tweak was mostly planned before the rise of this combo – especially because its usage in the combo was mostly for its links rather than its damage range – to make sure it doesn’t become another key Cosmions in another one shot build.


 Zapp Cooldown upped from 2 to 2.5


NEUTRAL BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Ishu cost in the shop is upped from 3 to 4. 


Developer’s Notes: We feel too much love is given to this Neutral Cosmion that others are jealous, so we decided to up its cost to reduce overperformance.

NATURE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Duopon: Upped its restoration trigger effect from 2 to 4
 Hercuvine: Link trigger restoration upped from 1 to 2


Developer’s Notes: Remember how we changed our tick rate bug in the game from 1 second to 2 back in the last patch… Well someone forgot to enhance restoration units for it to make sense.

FIRE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Dorangutan: Conditional effect of restoration upped from 3 to 5. 


Developer’s Note: Same logic as the Duopon and Hercuvine tweak listed above.

AIR BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Capcop: Reworked condition specific effects - on every successful attack, gain 1 damage.


Developer’s Note: Duelist and our own team didn’t really get a reason to make use of this Air Cosmion, so we decided to change it entirely into a gradually damage boosting machine.


 Aetherling and Galewing: Our air core units now do not scale with excess accuracy, but rather with every clarity you gain.


BUG SMASHED!

It's been a LONG time friends so if we wrote the full bug fixes, this already 1500+ words post would be double the size. Just know that we squashed almost all known bugs that were shared by the community, including some sneaky ones we believe none of you have ever encountered. 

That’s it for today! We know it’s a long read, but we believe that keeping a steady flow of communication with you all is key to the future of NeoDuel. For the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem. Till then, keep on dueling, and good luck!

Salutations, Duelists! As of Tuesday, June 25, 2024, a new patch has gone live for NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters. To experience the most recent and up to date build of NeoDuel demo on Steam, make sure you update your game.

IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS

NEUTRAL BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Pedro : The damage range was reduced from 7-10 to now 6-9, while energy cost was upped from 4 to 4.5. 
 Ishu: Cost reduced from 4 to 3. 


Developer’s Notes: Pedro while not being a strong Cosmion on its own stat-wise, is a very dominant Cosmions in the early game. We mean to cut that a little to push Duelist to pick other Cosmions.

NATURE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE

 Liskers: Cost raised from 5 to 7. 
 Spiry: Max damage upped from 4 to 5.

Developer’s Notes: We're seeing a raise in Liskers spam builds, and decided to up its cost to rein that down. If we end up seeing that happen again, we might consider another solution.

FIRE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Matchiro: Cost reduced from 4 to 3. Max damage upped from 4 to 6.


Developer’s Note: Matchiro is very weak because of his long history as being a key Cosmions in the Turbo Matchiro build, so we wanted to bring him back into play without making him a dominant pick.

WATER BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Cemil: Damage output range changed from 20-26 to 18-24.
 Strutwahl : Cost reduced from 8 to 7. 


AIR BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Drib: Accuracy lowered from 100 to 90 and cooldown upped from 2.5 to 3.
 Ageccus: Cooldown upped from 5 to 6, and price raised from 10 to 12.


Developer’s Notes:  Drib has been an easy-to-fuse Cosmions, but his main form is already too strong. This tweak should be enough of a damage cut, and push Duelist to experiment with fusions instead. As for Ageccus, we personally love seeing equinal-themed Backpacks, we had to pull the reins a bit stronger as they are too overpowered.

BUGFIXES


 Bug Fix: Focussed mind and Kikiyaon now calculate correctly (math is hard...)
 Bug Fix: Augment timings are fixed
 Inventory bug fixed: You should not encounter a weird blank screen now... Hopefully.
 Abatrion bug fix: The trigger effect now gives correct shield.
 Ishu, Leviathan and Siphon fix: These did not work as intended due to a strange coding error. Now that they do, you should try them out!


Developer’s Notes:  One of the main reasons Air was very strong element was due to the way the Critical damage was calculated. Now that we found the culprit, it should removes that sense of being an overpowered elements. As for the Augments, some of them didn't work sometimes, mainly due to a timing error which we fixed.

For the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem. Till then, keep on dueling, and good luck!

notes.notes:
Salutations, Duelists! As of Saturday, June 15, 2024, a new patch has gone live for NeoDuel: Backpack Monsters. To experience the most recent build of NeoDuel demo on Steam, make sure you update your game.

IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS

MISCELLANEOUS CHANGES


 New symbols for Essences and Bags: We used to have the same icon for Bags and Essences as our Cosmions, but now they got their own class icons! This means that Duelists cannot use Essences in certain key links, BUT we will be bringing more Cosmions with Essence links soon.


NEUTRAL BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Hawkista: Reworked to become a new Neutral Cosmion instead of Air. 


Developer’s Notes: While Hawkista IS a bird of prey, linking it to Air elementals indirectly guided Duelists to play it – almost – uniquely with Air Slimes. Our team DID NOT want that to be the outcome, so turning him Neutral will increase build variety.


 Hit Dicest: Link effect now stacks. Link number reduced from 3 to 2, and cooldown raised from 4.5 to 5.


Developer’s Notes: Essentially this is considered like an upgrade, we believe it will increase the game’s skill ceiling. If we see in our internal stats that it brought negative effect to the meta, we’ll probably raise the cooldown once more… But until then, this is the right balancing. 


 Revlana: Cooldown has been reduced from 4 to 3, and damage output range reduced from 12-16 to 10-14.
 Z E U S: Cooldown reduced from 4 to 3.5; Energy cost reduced from 5 to 4.


Developer’s Notes: After our last hotfix 0.7.1, we were afraid that Z E U S would to be too strong, but we ended up realizing it was exactly the opposite.


 Omnicore and Demoncore: Shop prices raised from 10 to 12.
 

Developer’s Notes: Although they aren’t necessarily strong, we noticed they have quite a high pick rate, so making them more expensive might tone that down. 


 •	Mira: Raised the cooldown from 2.5 to 3, and max damage went from 6 to 7. 
 

Developer’s Notes: The only reason we are making this change is that there’s too many elements in the game with a 2.5 cooldown. This resulted in a strange pattern of energy consumption in builds. While this change will reduce damage pace, Mira’s energy consumption should be more stable 

FIRE BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Pyrophate: Shield generation on activation reduced from 15 to 12.


Developer’s Note: Thankfully not many Duelists notice that, but Pyrophate one mean shield-making machine. This tuning should keep him a strong Cosmion and shieldmaster, but in a more balanced way.



 Firefist: Rarity reduced from Epic to Rare
 Molten Punch: Now requires fusion of two Firefists, instead of a combination of Knod, Firefist and Epic Fire Essence. The damage range was reduced from 38-42 to now 22-30. 


Developer’s Note:Since the launch of the demo, the Firefist and Molten Punch build was the LEAST PLAYED in the game. We are assuming that it’s a combination of Firefist being of Epic rarity while making a Molten Punch was quite a grind. This change should help people get into this build, as well as fusing Molten Punch, earlier. To counter potential abuse, we felt that we needed to tone down the maximum power.



 Dorangutan: Coodlown upped from 4 to 4.5


WATER BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Runghai: Damage output range changed from 25-30 to 34-42, while Cooldown were raised from 2.5 to 3
 Cemil: Damage output range changed from 15-20 to 20-26, while Cooldown was raised from 2 to 3. Finally slight upgrade to energy from 2 to 2.5. 


Developer’s Notes:  Cemil is a great driving “flow” behind many builds, but that 2 second cooldown made it indispensable with strength and other damage buffs. We decided to turn that down a bit, while upping the damage it can cause.

AIR BASED COSMION & ESSENCE


 Aetherling: Minimum damage reduced from 11 to 10
 Galewing: Minimum damage reduced from 18 to 16
 Volucris: Damage output range reduced from 35-42 to 30-35


Developer’s Notes:  Duelists are loving Air elementals, and they’re not wrong. Air might be too good now, but we found the main culprits and got “grounded”.

BUGFIXES


 Bug Fix: Units will not turn after the start of a Duel. While we thought this was only a visual bug, it affected links and cost lots of Duels for some players. If you encounter it again, please let us know (although we’re confident you won’t).
 Bug Fix: Air Critical insane numbers fixed
 Bug Fix: Duckduck, Fireduck and Knod link energy now reduces at the right pace instead of double the value.


For the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem. Till then, keep on dueling, and good luck!

notes.title: NeoDuel: Demo Patch Notes (Version 0.7.0) - Steam Next Fest Edition
notes.notes:
It’s been a wild couple of days since our last patch note, but in case you missed it, we have a new publishing partner - The 4 Winds Entertainment - who will support us as we get NeoDuel closer to the finish line and onward. That means our patch notes will become a bit more “fun” and clear, and follow certain formatting for better accessibility.

This upcoming patch for the NeoDuel demo is slightly heavier on content, since we’ll be highlighted in the upcoming Steam Next Fest. Our team has been hard at work adding a plethora of new content and features, a reshape to the existing meta but without breaking some of the top duelist builds out there… Just, you know, stopping some exploits, while keeping things fresh.

NEW CONTENT FOR THE GAME:

New Feature: Battle Log

A lot of Duelists wanted this, and we finally did it. You can now see which of your Cosmion did the most damage or synergy, and find out the weaker chain in the link. It’s a full log feature that splits data into damage count, healing and shield values, and other effects applied. We will be listening to all of you Duelists’ feedback on this feature, and work toward a more complex or tweaked version of the Battle Log as we get closer to the full launch. 

New Feature: Fusion Bond

" Fuuu...sion..HA!” 

Alright, you probably guessed by now that we're a bunch of weebs. We love the fusion abilities of our beloved Cosmions, but some of you felt like the outcome of fusing wasn't clear. With the Fusion Bond, you can now see which Cosmions can fuse together, and the potential outcome.

New Feature: Additional Keyboard Shortcuts


 Added the ability to rotate Cosmions using the Q and E keys.
 Added the ability to quickly send Cosmions to the bag with the S key or the Mouse Right Click


New Cosmions

We have been working hard on designing and bringing new critters into the game which will increase the depth, enhance your Duelist experience and fill all the blanks a potential build could have. 
We start with unique Cosmions, which are found in the Fire, Water and Air elemental category, but missing in the rest. With this patch 0.7.0 codename Steam Fest, all elements have their “ultimate” Cosmions including: 


 Z E U S: Powered by the iconic electric deity, each energy you generate will add damage to that Cosmion. 
 Faeris: The God of nature is here to protect you. This Cosmion increases all shields you gain
 Revlana: No elemental power doesn’t mean weakness. This Cosmion grows in strength the more you have a variety of other elements in play.


Other than that, we’ve added some a set of 8 new Cosmions to spice things up: 


 Pedro: Pedro, Pedro, Pedro, Pedro, Pè. A common attacker that uses a lot of energy but hits really hard.
 Stonks Doge: A new fusion-based Cosmum lets you use those useless stonks tigresses in a useful way.
 ChugChug: We heard that there are energy problems, which we think will be solved with this fusion Cosmium!
 Arthur: Coming from the wild depth, this gunslinger will solve those pesky flow problems by converting your energy into flow!
 Meteor Klood: The long awaited Fire elemental cloud that was missing from the “kloodline”. It will inflict 1 fog, 2 burn and 2 Lava Burn.
 Ishu: Kawaii! A Cosmiun disguised as a sushi, and acts as a defender for - mostly - Fire duelist. Each time you inflict a debuff to your enemy, you recover 1 health
 Pyrophyte: A tree shaped Cosmion which gathers strength by burning inside out. Everytime you deal burn damage to the enemy, it gains shield.
 Harmonion: Fight water with fire? Turns your flow into burn, allowing for some interesting builds.


Developer’s Note: As our current Duelists keep playing the game, we have noticed some problems that aren’t balancing problems, but rather a lack of pieces to finish the puzzle, and those are new Cosmions. As we continue to update this demo, and march towards the full launch, we will keep experimenting with unique Cosmions, in hope it will boost your imagination and wildess builds. 


New Zone: Heart

Zones can bring some interesting changes to gameplay, and this new Heart Zone is a big pill of vitamins. For every Cosmion with a passive effect in this zone, your Duelist will gain 10 HP on top of your cap.

IMPROVEMENTS & ADJUSTMENTS

Onboarding and Tutorial

A lot of the community feedback made us realize that the first-time user experience is not where we want it to be. We’re constantly improving on that front, and tweaked the previous tutorial by timing better the on-screen messaging based on Duelist actions, as well as adding an explanation of the Cosmion description card. This is not yet reflective of the final form of the tutorial for the full launch, so keep that feedback coming!

Upgrade Balancing

As we launched the first version of the demo, we noticed that plenty of upgrades were not balanced at all, and we didn't really implement the best system for them. To resolve that, we are going to be separating each stage of upgrades into their own tier, from 1 to 3. Upgrades get more valuable as you progress in the duels, and you will feel it as well. We are also bringing some new upgrades to change the pace on that front.

Unique Cosmion Pricing Reduced

Unique cosmions are those you could only get from upgrades, yet had a price tag of 30. We realized from our data that they were becoming tools to pick and sell, so we reduced their cost to 20.

Cosmion & Essence Balancing & Changes

Fire-based Cosmion & Essence 


 Ifry burn per link has been reduced from 2 to 1
 Ifraltus burn per link has been reduced from 3 to 2
 Rare Fire Essence burn effect has been reduced from 3 to 2 
 Epic Fire Essence burn effect has been reduced from 6 to 4
 Porgur cost reduced from 2 to 1


Developer's note: Let's talk about the typical fire build here, because there are a couple changes we are bringing into this element to tweak things for Duelists. There are two big problems with Fire builds at the moment: it is very easy to play efficiently, and there is A LOT of starting Burn effect. This is not what we want for a ramping build, so we’re removing a lot of initial Burn effects. To not shatter all current builds, we are also adding some new elemental optimized units so seasoned Duelists can still bring the summer heat.


 Firefist link effect has been upgraded from 2 to 3
 Moltenpunch link effect has been upgraded from 4 to 5


Developer's note: Firefist build is the least popular line in the game according to our stats. Reducing a start build will disrupt too much the meta, so we wanted to make sure you still aim for a perfect link, without removing THAT much burn effect. 


 Fire Mira damage has been reduced from a range of 6-8 to 5-7
 Yogan damage has been reduced from a range of 7-10 to 6-8


Developer's note: With the new Cosmions we’re introducing in the Fire category, some base damage from the most used ones needed to be tweaked.

Nature Based Cosmion & Essence


 Spiry energy cost per attack has been reduced from 3 to 2
 Abatis cost has been reduced from 6 to 5


Developer's note: For Spiry, the intended gameplay was for a Duelist to put more of them in play to eventually take advantage of the fusion, but currently, even if you had no other Cosmions, you would be out of energy. This didn't quite make sense so we had to introduce this fix. 

Air-based Cosmion & Essence


 Volucris reworked: Changed fusion from Yekrut + Ageccus + Epic Air Essence to now Yekrut + Clepius. Its cooldown is bigger, changing from 3 to 4, and the on-hit haste was removed. 
 Volucris’ passive “Giving critical stats to the linked Cosmion” is now “On attack phase give the linked Cosmion 20% critical damage change”.


Developer's note: The Air elemental big boy was a little hard to reach and too important in winduelists, discouraging them to trade. What we are doing is making it a lot easier to fuse a Volucris, and tuning him accordingly. The old passive ability felt limiting for duelists, as most didn’t want to apply critical stats to a linked Cosmion. This one will lead to stronger end-game boards for more fun late duels. 

Electric based Cosmion & Essence


 Belestra Rework: Changed fusion from Wasbuz + rare nature + rare electric essence to now Wasbuz + Rare Nature. Its cooldown has changed from 2 to 5, Stamina from 2 to 4, Damage range from a range of 15-21 to 18-22 and finally added 20% innate critical chance. 


Developer's note: Do we even need to explain this one? Belestra has been a very strong Cosmion that needed to be contained so it doesn’t go berserk. The tweaks are meant for it to be easier to fuse, but still keep him fun to play.


 Zapp cost reduced from 3 to 2
 Tesla cost reduced from 9 to 8


Developer’s note: Most of our original testers and alpha demo Duelists remember the “nuke it tesla” build, which was VERY scary. For those lucky enough to have not witnessed that dark era, that build could sort of one-shot you at the start of the duel. WE DO NOT want to see those ever again, but we do feel like we overdid it with the previous changes, so we’re balancing to a nice middle ground.


Neutral based Cosmion & Essence


 Demoncore-Omnicore link amount changes from 4 to 6 to be fully activated.


Developer's note: Our team loves these 2 Cosmions, but our internal stats reveal that they are being used too often based on how easily they can be linked. To make sure they are not activated EVERY time a Duelist buys them in the shop, we had to up the link cap for a full activation to now 6, and might add more if we feel these are still too easy.

Water-based Cosmion & Essence 


 Common Water Essence flow reduced from 3 to 2
 Rare Water Essence flow reduced from 5 to 4
 Epic Water Essence flow reduced from 9 to 8


Developer's note: Similar to the changes brought to the Fire essences, we realized that Duelists are using too much Essences in comparison with Cosmions, which isn’t really their purpose in the game (you are a monster tamer after all).

For us, Essences are complimentary slots into your backpack, while Cosmions are your priority. Essences only take 1 slot and are used in fusions, which make them on par with the core mechanic of a Cosmion but at a reduced cost. This change to the Water essences should keep that trend down, and we will constantly monitor the situation. 

BUG SMASHED!


 Bargain Master: We discovered an unintended loop that could be considered an exploit by our system, between fusions of David E. Sence and the Bargain Master upgrade. This ability has been dropped in the bin to keep the in-game economy healthy… Plus, there’s a big chance you didn’t even discover it. 
 Numerous bugs squished in the background that haven't done that much damage for Duelist… Those darn sneaky bugs.


For the most recent news, join the NeoDuel community by following us on Twitter or hopping into the T4W Discord server. Please contact our support channel on the T4W Discord server if you need assistance with typical technical issues or if you are unable to resolve your problem. Till then, keep on dueling, and good luck!

notes.title: Demo 0.6.4 - Major Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Duelists,

It's patch day and it's already live! 
While we collect our smaller updates in this thread, this is a big one and includes some news, so here are they!

If you want to stay in touch further, don't forget to follow us on Twitter or join our Discord.

System Changes:
- Elo System Reworked, let us know how it feels!
- Links added to Cosmions with no links or only 1 link. This will increase the skill expression overall.
- Some on-trigger Cosmions now only work with Attackers as they were letting some truly overpowered combos to happen (Shown as "⚔️ Link" in game)
- Some Upgrades Reworked: Discover them in-game and let us know what you think! :)

🔺🔻General Balance
- In-battle Player HP increased: Fights will take slightly longer and will let some new ramp-up builds to work.
- Credit amount increased in each Stage: You'll get to make more meaningful choices in shop.
- Fog, Toughness and Brittle now diminish over time. We'll keep an eye on this and balance Cosmions that provide these buff / debuffs to companse with the next patch. 
- Fusion formula adjustments

🔺🔻👾Cosmion Adjustmens
- Nerfs: Riko, Omnicore, Demoncore, Fire Mira, Flinter
- Buffs: Firefist, Blazeroll, All the Ducks
- Balanced: Air Cosmions (Less Energy usage, more damage, hence further synergy with Crit!)
- Other minor nerf and buffs

We hope you'll enjoy this version!
Our team is hard at work to bring you more content and better balance as time goes. Now, we'll be focusing on a big Next Fest Update with many new Cosmions on June 10th! 

Until then, we'll keep making small balance changes and bug-fixes whenever required.

For the Next Fest, we're planning:
- At least 5 New Cosmions
- New Avatars
- QoL improvements
- Balance changes

If you want to stay in touch further, don't forget to follow us on Twitter or join our Discord.

See you then!
